question.text: Which of the following pairs of compounds are more stable?

options.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><msub><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup></math>

<math><msup><mrow><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><msub><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mo>)</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced close="]" open="[" separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math>

solution.text: By comparing the value of ionization energies the thermodynamic stability of transition metal compound can be compared. Ionization value shows that <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> compound are more stable then <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mo>)</mo></math> compound while <math><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">t</mi><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>)</mo></math> compound are relatively more stable than <math><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">i</mi><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">I</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>)</mo></math> .
